package.name: arm_ik
package.description: URDF-driven 7-DOF inverse kinematics for both TienKung 2.0 Pro arms. Joint axes, origins, limits and TCP transforms are parsed from robot_description or an explicitly configured URDF file. The node accepts PoseStamped and TwistStamped goals, computes bounded joint trajectories and optionally publishes motor commands through bodyctrl_msgs.
